newsitem.title: USA: Toy Biz says Marvel cannot replace board.
newsitem.headline: Toy Biz says Marvel cannot replace board.

text.p: Toy Biz Inc said Monday that Marvel Entertainment Group Inc has no power to name a majority of Toy Biz's board members, and Toy Biz will take legal action to resist any such move by Marvel.
On Friday, after Marvel's bondholders won control of that bankrupt comic book publisher, they said they had ousted the board of Toy Biz.
The bondholders said Marvel controls 70 percent of Toy Biz shares.
But Toy Biz said in a news release today that Marvel actually owns about 27 percent of Toy Biz's outstanding shares.
Toy Biz said the change in control of Marvel terminated the super-voting rights associated with Toy Biz's Class B common stock owned by Marvel, reducing Marvel's effective stake.
Toy Biz said five members of its board associated with the previous Marvel board had resigned. The five were officers of Marvel or of McAndrews & Forbes Holdings Inc.
Toy Biz said its remaining directors will replace the five, but not with representatives of the new Marvel board.
Marvel on Friday said it had replaced eight of Toy Biz's 11 board members.
Toy Biz said today that it "intends to take appropriate legal action to protect itself from interference with its affairs."
